title: Every unrecruited crew member says only "..." until their recruit beat unlocks
repro: Gangster arc: reach the docks before beating the dock boss and talk to Specs, Ladder, Halo or Marlene (Crew.place puts them there from the first visit); same for Dice/The Kid/Doc in neon before Flame, and Vic/Val/Sasha in the underground pit before it is won. region._talk_npc: Story.talk false (beat gated on boss_docks/boss_neon/boss_underground or the manifest), Hearts/Quests nothing, Crew.talk returns false for unrecruited, no region npc lines -> falls to {"text": "..."}. Nine of twelve recruits are mute props on first meeting; the recruit's want is only told in a hint.
fix: Add a 'waiting' list per member in data/crew.json (2-3 in-voice lines that say what they want / what has to happen first, e.g. Ladder: 'Dock boss owns the crane. Move him and come up.'; Specs: 'No paper, no talk.'; Sasha: 'Win the pit first.'). In Crew.talk, when not recruited and not <id>_refused, play one line (day-rotated) and return true; add the hint once (flag crew_hint_<id>).

area: crew recruits: Marlene after the letter is sold
title: Selling the letter leaves Marlene on the docks forever, unrecruitable and mute
repro: Keep or memorise the letter, beat the dock boss, talk to Marlene, choose 'Sell it'. Flags letter_sold/president_knows/letter_decided; she never gets crew_marlene or a _refused flag, so Crew.place keeps standing her at docks [12,17] for the rest of the game and every later talk is '...' (no beat matches: all four Marlene beats need not letter_decided). Dice in the same situation walks off (dice_refused); Marlene just stands there.
fix: Either give her post-sale lines and set marlene_refused after one closing beat (she walks, like Dice), or add a late buy-in beat (e.g. after boss_neon: 'Paper's gone, money's spent. You still need a fence.' for a price) so the choice has a cost but a way back. Hand-edited story.json beat + crew.json waiting lines.
needs_tom: Should a player who sold the letter be able to win Marlene back later (and at what cost), or should she leave for good?

title: Recruit choice flags deuce_thumb and dice_scared are set but never read; president_knows only blocks Dice
repro: grep the repo: deuce_thumb (catch Deuce's trick) and dice_scared (lean on the pawnbroker) appear only in data/story.json. Deuce says 'I'm never doing that one for you again' and Dice is recruited by intimidation, but no later line, loyalty scene, everyday line or epilogue reflects either choice. STORY.md says selling the letter makes 'the Enforcer stronger' too; nothing reads president_knows except g4_dice/g4_dice_knows.
fix: Crew.talk everyday lines: one extra line per flag (Deuce: 'Still not doing the thumb one.'; Dice with dice_scared: 'The pawnbroker crosses the street when he sees me now. Is that... good?'); optional epilogue.json lines via gen_epilogue.py keyed on the flags. Either implement the Enforcer buff for president_knows (enemy hp_scale in the uptown spawn) or drop that sentence from docs/STORY.md.

title: 'Pull the stone' (free) ending is always offered; STORY.md gates it on Doc at loyalty 3
repro: g5_win offers 'Pull the stone out of him.' to every player. docs/STORY.md Chapter 5: 'Ending free (Doc at loyalty 3 and you choose to pull the shard)'. Doc's loyalty-3 scene ('There's a man in there') therefore has no effect on the redemption, and Doc may not even be recruited.
fix: Pick one: (a) add a Doc line before the choice when doc_loyal_3 ('There's a man in there. I've seen him.') and keep the choice open to all, updating STORY.md; or (b) gate option 0 with a 'gates' entry {flag: doc_loyal_3} and an in-voice refusal. (a) is friendlier.
needs_tom: Should the 'free the President' ending need Doc at loyalty 3 (as the story doc says) or stay open to everyone?

title: Deuce/Rosa/Doc recruit menus have no B way-out: the deferral option isn't a recognised way-out word
repro: g2_deuce last option 'Not yet.', g2_rosa 'I'll come back with them.', g4_doc 'I'll bring them.' are keyed story choices (deuce_join/rosa_join/doc_join), so Dialogue.is_way_out(text, false) only accepts WAY_OUT words (leave/back/never mind/not now...). B does nothing on these three menus; Dice's 'Not now.' works. The option is a pure deferral (it unflags st_<beat>), not a decision.
fix: Reword to start with 'Not now' : 'Not now.', 'Not now. I'll bring ten crops.', 'Not now. I'll find the herbs.'

title: Paying a recruit takes crops/money silently, and take_crops empties your biggest crop stacks first
repro: g2_rosa choice 0: Story._play_lines calls GameState.take_crops(10) with no toast; take_crops sorts by stack size and takes from the largest (could be gold-star or quest crops). g2_deuce/g4_dice pay via effects crystals -150/-300, which _apply adds with no toast either. Items paths (Doc's herbs) do toast.
fix: In _play_lines' crops gate, record what take_crops removed (return a dict from a local copy or diff inventory) and toast '-10 crops (6 Turnip, 4 Potato)'; in _apply toast negative 'crystals' with Money.amount. Optionally prefer lowest-value crops in take_crops (GameState) - leave game_state.gd alone if another package owns it.

title: Story payouts (Marlene's 2000, shop deals 600/800) bypass GameState.add_money
repro: Story._apply: if fx.has('crystals'): run['crystals'] += n. Positive amounts (sell_letter +2000, shop_1 +600, shop_2 +800, shop_3) never reach earned_total/earned_by, so the Hero tab lifetime total and any earned_by source report miss them (CLAUDE.md: money earned goes through GameState.add_money(n, source)).
fix: In _apply: if n > 0: GameState.add_money(n, 'story') else keep the direct subtraction.

title: Ladder's join hint promises raid warnings he can't give yet; Halo says 'Say where.' when she can't drive
repro: g3_ladder hint: 'He'll warn you before a raid.' but raid_warning is perk_level>=1, which needs a loyalty talk at the hideout (loyalty starts 0). Crew.talk everyday lines for Halo include 'Say where.', shown out in the districts below loyalty 3 or before loyalty 1, where no ride menu follows.
fix: Hint: 'Ladder counts trucks. Talk to him at the hideout and he'll warn you before a raid.' Replace Halo's 'Say where.' everyday line with 'Hideout's where I park. Find me there.' (or only use it when a ride is possible).

title: Recruit tasks STORY.md describes (crane climb, dock race, Kid's board, beating Sasha, scaring the gambler) are all instant narration
repro: Talk to Ladder/Halo/The Kid/Sasha after the district boss: each joins in one talk with the task told in narration (g4_kid: 'You bring it back.'; g3_halo: 'You don't win...'). Specs, Ladder, Halo, The Kid and Sasha cost nothing once the boss flag is set; only Deuce, Rosa, Dice, Doc ask for anything. Recruitment has almost no play compared with the Marked fights.
fix: Turn one or two into small real tasks with existing systems: The Kid's board as a placed key item under the dragon sign in neon (thing type story item, beat when item:kid_board); Halo's race as a timed run along the dock road (start/finish area triggers, fail = retry next day). Update STORY.md to match whatever stays narrated.
art_needed: If the board becomes a pickup: one small prop 'props/kid_board' (skateboard with a cat sticker).
needs_tom: Worth making the Kid's board and Halo's race playable, or keep recruits talk-only?

title: Dice refuses you on your first neon visit, before anyone has mentioned him, and the Flame hint still lists his debt
repro: Sell the letter, go to neon for the first time and talk to Dice: g4_dice_knows has when {flag: president_knows} with no boss_neon, so he refuses and leaves before the chapter introduces him; afterwards g4_flame still adds the hint 'Dice owes the pawnbroker for a busted scooter' for someone who is gone.
fix: Add boss_neon to g4_dice_knows.when (until then the waiting line from the pre-recruit finding plays), and split g4_flame's hint so the Dice clause is skipped with dice_refused/president_knows (e.g. a second hint in a flags_if-style or a separate tiny beat).

title: Crew tab shows the raw-loyalty perk, ignoring the Training Center drill that raises perk_level; recruited crew can never be given gifts
repro: Build training tier 2+: Crew.perk_level adds the drill bonus, but game_menu._crew_tab prints perks[loyalty-1] and 'no perk yet' at loyalty 0, so the roster understates what is active. Separately, Crew.talk always returns true for recruited members (everyday line), so region._talk_npc never reaches the gift path although Crew.data registers them with likes and friendship.
fix: _crew_tab: show the perk for mini(3, loyalty + drill) and mark '(drilled)'. Crew.talk: when the selected item is giftable (GameState.can_gift), return false before the everyday line so the gift confirm runs.

title: The day-3 partner pick is one-shot: 'Nobody, for now' or the one you didn't pick can never join later
repro: Gangster run, day 3 farm gate: choose 'Nobody, for now' (or pick Sal over Big Jim). farm.gd sets flags.partner_scene once; nothing in story.json gangsters (no 'companion'/'know' effects) or any script recruits big_jim/sal/dad/mom/pax/kairi afterwards, so the player never gets a partner (only Marked/Mer). The Party tab still says 'Partners find you as the story goes; some wait at the farm gate.' which is untrue here.
fix: Let unchosen partners be asked later: Big Jim stands at the hideout once hideout_seen (place via Crew.place-like hook) with a talk choice 'Ride with me?' -> Companion.recruit('big_jim'); Sal in town gets a 'Come with me' option after g1_sal when not in party; if 'Nobody' was chosen, re-offer at the farm gate 3 days later (partner_scene_again flag). Line ideas: Big Jim 'You paid me in silence last time. Silence doesn't buy fuel. ...I'm in.'

title: Sal can follow you as your partner and still sit on the town bench, and g1_sal has him join a second time
repro: Pick Sal at the day-3 farm gate. He follows you as the companion, but town still places the Sal NPC (town.gd only hides him for penguins before day 4), so there are two Sals in town. Talk to bench Sal after clear_meadow: g1_sal plays 'If you're building something... I'm in. Call it rent.' although he already rides with you. If you picked Big Jim instead, the same 'I'm in' sets sal_recruited but he never joins the party.
fix: town.gd: skip placing the Sal NPC while Companion.active_id()=='sal' (talk to the follower instead), or keep him and change g1_sal: add a line with if_flag party_sal ('Told you at the gate. I'm already in. Here's what I know.') and unless_flag party_sal for the 'I'm in' lines; for the Big Jim case: 'You took Jim. Fine. I'm still in, just from the bench.'

title: Marked and lieutenants who 'join the crew' never appear at the hideout or in the Crew roster
repro: Beat Kit at the hideout and choose 'Come with us': toast 'Kit joins the crew', but Crew.place only places data/crew.json members, so Kit is never at the hideout and has no talk lines; she only exists as a Party follower. Same for Old Mags and Brock after 'Come with us' (game_map._lieutenant_choice sets lt_joined_* and a stat bonus; epilogue says they 'work with your crew now') - invisible for the rest of the game. The Crew section of MENU > Party lists neither.
fix: Crew.place: also place Marked with state 'crew' (not the active companion) and lt_joined_ mags/brock at free hideout cells; give each 2-3 hideout lines in tools/gen_gifts.py (e.g. Kit: 'The wind's quieter here. I like it.'; Brock: 'Forty-one fights. One loss. Best thing that happened to me.'; Mags: 'Back roads are clear, sugar.'). game_menu._crew_tab: a 'Also with you' block listing joined Marked/lieutenants.

title: Marked yield choice has no per-character reaction: both outcomes end on a generic toast
repro: Beat any Marked: yield + origin lines, then 'Come with us' / 'Go home' and only a toast ('Juno joins the crew. Pick them in Menu > Party...' / 'Juno walks...'). The character never answers your decision, so the redemption moment lands on UI text. data/companions.json mk_* 'join' just repeats the origin line already shown.
fix: gen_gifts.py MARKED: add join_line and home_line per Marked; marked.gd: say it before the toast. Examples: Kit join 'Okay. But I'm not slow. You're slow.' / home 'Mum's going to kill me. ...Good.'; Ember join 'Nothing burns unless you say so. Deal.' / home 'They're rebuilding the house. Maybe I can help.'; Bruno join 'You waited. I'll wait for you.' / home 'Foundry's hiring again. Without the stone.'; Atlas home 'Lonely way to win. I'll go find some people.'. Also set companions mk_* 'join' to join_line.

title: 'Come with us' is offered to every lieutenant but six of eight give the same refusal; the 'beaten' outcome is unreachable
repro: Beat Vance, Flame, Silas, Pike, Ostrova or the Surveyor: _lieutenant_choice offers 'Come with us. Work for the crew.' and all six answer the identical 'Work for you? I'd rather walk. Don't worry. I'm done with him too.' Every lieutenant kill goes through this choice and both options set lt_spared_ or lt_joined_, so epilogue lt_lines 'beaten' can never show (except in 'take' ending via how==beaten, also unreachable).
fix: Give each lieutenant their own refusal line in a LT_REFUSE dict (Vance: 'I've worked one boss too many. I'll take a boat.'; Lucia: 'I'll find a street with no signs on it.'; Silas: 'I'll file my own resignation.'; Pike: 'Last train out. I'm on it.'; Ostrova: 'I'll count someone else's money. Honestly, for once.'). Optionally a third option 'Tell the President I'm coming.' (no flag = beaten) so all three epilogue lines can occur. Keep the edit small in game_map.gd or move the dict/function to a new scripts/lieutenants.gd.

title: Sasha's recruit and loyalty lines ignore that Brock (the champion she carries out) may have joined your crew
repro: Beat Brock in the pit and choose 'Come with us' (lt_joined_brock). Then talk to Sasha: g4_sasha 'You beat the champion. The champion was soft. I'm the one who carries the champion out.'; her first loyalty scene 'I carried the champion out nine times...'. Neither acknowledges the champion is now on your side, and g4_twins ('We fight the winner') plays the same.
fix: g4_sasha: add a line with if_flag lt_joined_brock: 'And then you hired him. Either you're soft too, or you see something. I'll find out which.' Twins: if_flag lt_joined_brock Vic: 'You kept the champion?' Val: 'Smart. He hits like a wall.'

area: partners (penguin arc): recruit scenes as a story character
title: Campfire and Coldy recruit scenes break when you play as Nova, Big Jim or Coldy
repro: p3_campfire effects know: 'penguin_f' is hard-coded and its hint says 'Nova is with you again': playing Nova, nobody catches up (Story._apply skips the hero) and the hint is wrong; Pip-Pip never rejoins. Playing Big Jim: _fill drops his own lines, but the narration still says 'Out of the shadows jumps a large figure' and the hint 'Big Jim tags along on the climb'. Playing Coldy: p3_coldy keeps her choice line ('But I must come with you...') because choice lines aren't dropped, so Coldy asks herself to join.
fix: Split p3_campfire into two beats by hero (when playable via a new 'hero'/'not_hero' cond, or not_flag on a hero flag) with know: 'penguin_m' and a matching hint for a Nova run; give Big-Jim-hero a narration variant ('You walk the valley alone; a fox watches, then follows.'). p3_coldy: for a Coldy hero, a variant where a baby penguin steps up instead ('Coldy says you are our big sister now. I hold the key while you are away.').

title: STORY.md has Big Jim breaking the tower doors, but he has no line anywhere in the gangster arc even when he's your partner
repro: docs/STORY.md Ch5: 'otherwise Sasha and Big Jim break them'. story.json gangsters contains no Big Jim line (count 0); g5_doors_force only has Sasha (if_flag crew_sasha). A player who picked Big Jim on day 3 gets no partner beat in the finale; the partner never speaks in any gangster scene after the farm gate.
fix: g5_doors_force: add {who:'Big Jim', text:'You pay, I swing. Today it's free.', if_flag:'party_big_jim'} after Sasha's line; g5_epilogue: a partner line with %partner, e.g. {who:'%partner', text:'Told you I'd see it through.'} gated on any party_* flag.

title: A Marked's introduction is only a toast that appears as the fight starts
repro: Walk into a Marked's district (e.g. docks after st_g2_arrive): Marked.on_enter spawns them 96 px away and shows one toast 'Ember Reyes, "Matchstick": The docks are mine...' while the boss song starts; no portrait, no pause, no boss card (other named foes get m.boss_card). On a phone, mid-movement, the name, age and line of ten story characters are easy to miss, and the yield scene later assumes you met them.
fix: Freeze the player briefly and say the intro as a Dialogue line with their portrait ({who: name, text: intro}), then show m.boss_card('marked_'+id, name + ' "' + epithet + '"') if a card exists (fallback: keep the toast). Keep the spawn after the line closes.
